advice: Cut down infected pseudostems at ground level. Disinfect machetes and hoes with fire or sodium hypochlorite bleach. Strictly de-bud using a forked stick.
advice_luganda: Temako ebitooke ebirwadde wansi ku ttaka. Yosa ebiwabyo mu muliro oba obinnyike mu jik. Tokwata bisigalira kubitwala mu nnimiro ndala.

advice: Uproot curling or chlorotic plants immediately. Inspect fields for silverleaf whiteflies (Bemisia tabaci). Plant certified resistant varieties (e.g., NASE 14).
advice_luganda: Simbula ebiwuka ebikyamye ebiraga obulwadde bwa mosaic. Kebera obuwuka obweru. Simbamu emiti egigumira obulwadde.

advice: Prune shade and excess branches to lower humidity around the canopy. Apply registered copper-based protective fungicide prior to the onset of seasonal rains.
advice_luganda: Saalira emiti gy'emmwanyi okuyingiza empewo era osaaseeko eddagala lya kopa erikakasibwa ng'enkuba tenatandika.
